chapter:
# Moves

A move transfers ownership to the new binding.

A variable whose value was moved cannot be used again.

questions.question: You pass a String to a function and then print it. Why does the compiler refuse?
questions.reference_answer: Passing the String moves ownership into the function, and a variable whose value was moved cannot be used again, so the later print uses a moved-from variable.
